Phase.description_en:
The status of the dataset acceleration slot mount target. Valid values:  

Created: Creation completed.  
ResourceAllocating: Resource request in progress.  
ResourceAllocated: Resource request completed.  
Ready: Ready.  
Stopping: Stopping.  
Failed: Failed.  
Stopped: Stopped.
Phase.description_zh:
数据集加速槽挂载点的状态。 取值如下：

Created：已创建。
ResourceAllocating：资源申请中。
ResourceAllocated：资源申请完成。
Ready：已就绪。
Stopping：停止中。 
Failed：已失败。 
Stopped：已停止
Phase.title: 数据集加速槽挂载点所处状态。 Created：已创建 ResourceAllocating：资源申请中 ResourceAllocated：资源申请完成 Ready：已就绪 Stopping：停止中 Failed：已失败 Stopped：已停止

The IP-port mapping of the services provided by the dataset acceleration slot mount target (Endpoint).  
The key is the UUID of the dataset acceleration slot providing the service.  
The value is the IP-port information.
